propositions: The sidecar channel allowlist admits gate-run limits (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but drops consumption measurements (requests, tool_calls), preventing actionable diagnostics on disk.

Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic parameter, resulting in zero recorded counters for plan-review preflight, code-review preflight, and completion preflight failures.
The completion verdict sidecar carries no run metadata (requests, tool_calls, duration) while the plan-review sidecar already carries per-call metrics, creating asymmetry between the two gates.
Gate-run consumption metrics survive to the local usage-log but not to the shared ticket store, making per-checkout analysis possible but blocking store-wide auditing via rebar audit show.
Plan-review and completion gates must record consumed counters symmetrically in the sidecar so that per-ticket aggregate costs and call-failure rates become answerable from the store.
